body.name: \((\widehat\tau_n,\widehat V_n)\)
body.construction: For one fixed certified input on the equality branch, set \(\widehat\tau_n=(T_{D_0,y}(\widehat p_n))_y=\tau(\widehat p_n)\) on the event \(\min_{D,y}B_{D,y}(\widehat p_n)>0\), set \(\widehat\Sigma_n=\operatorname{diag}(\widehat p_n)-\widehat p_n\widehat p_n^{\mathsf T}\), and set \(\widehat V_n=J_{\tau}(\widehat p_n)\widehat\Sigma_nJ_{\tau}(\widehat p_n)^{\mathsf T}\). Set \(\widehat\tau_n=0\) and \(\widehat V_n=0\) off that event.
